The Indonesian tiger perch, Datnioides microlepis, is a large tiger perch from Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Indonesian Borneo.
It is unclear whether its range extends into peninsular Thailand, while records from the Chao Phraya and Mekong river basins refer to the congener D. pulcher.

regions.name: Kapuas
regions.quote: Apparently restricted to the Malay Peninsula and western Indonesia, where it is known from the Perak and Selangor river systems in Peninsular Malaysia, Batang Hari and Musi watersheds in Sumatra, and Kapuas basin in Kalimantan (Indonesian Borneo).
